email.body1:
Ryan, saw nOps cross $4B in managed cloud spend across 600+ customers as an AWS Advanced partner.

At that scale, the partner and PE ecosystem worth co-selling into is far larger than any team can personally cover, so partner-sourced pipeline plateaus right when the ecosystem is hottest. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner network on its own: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for the nOps partner ecosystem off your AWS and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for nOps.

Most partnerships orgs cannot scale co-sell motions across every partner and portfolio company at once, so coverage gets uneven and partner-sourced pipeline stalls. The fix is consistent, personalized outreach into the ecosystem without adding heads.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook, how the AI SDR runs partner-aligned outreach across your AWS and PE ecosystem so partner-sourced pipeline scales without new hires.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for nOps.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how nOps's reply rate likely compares to other infrastructure companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running GTM and PE partnerships at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a partner motion? I will tailor it to nOps either way.
